entities.summary: Atlasov Island, also known as Alaid Island , is the northernmost island of the Kuril Islands, part of the Sakhalin Oblast in Russia. The Russian name is sometimes rendered in English as Atlasova Island. In it is located Alaid volcano, the highest volcano of the Kurils and one of the most active.
